description: Comprehensive testing and verification: fix all tests, add integration tests, implement verification pipeline, add performance tests and monitoring
steps: Fix all remaining failing tests in backend/tests/ directory.
Create comprehensive integration test suite in backend/tests/test_recommendation_integration.py covering all agent interactions.
Implement automated verification pipeline in backend/scripts/verify_recommendations.py that checks system health and recommendation quality.
Add performance tests in backend/tests/test_recommendation_performance.py for recommendation generation under load.
Create monitoring dashboard with backend/app/api/routes/monitoring.py and frontend monitoring page.
Add stress tests for concurrent agent calls and edge cases.
Ensure test coverage > 80% for recommendation system modules.
Create documentation for testing and verification procedures.
acceptance_criteria: All tests pass without timeouts or failures
Integration tests cover all critical agent interaction paths
Verification pipeline runs automatically and reports system status
Performance tests show system meets latency requirements under expected load
Monitoring dashboard shows system health, error rates, and performance metrics
Test coverage > 80% for recommendation agent modules
Stress tests verify system stability under concurrent load
verification: cd backend && python -m pytest tests/ -v (all tests pass)
cd backend && python -m pytest tests/test_recommendation_integration.py -v (integration tests pass)
cd backend && python scripts/verify_recommendations.py (verification pipeline runs successfully)
cd backend && python -m pytest tests/test_recommendation_performance.py -v (performance tests pass within thresholds)
Check monitoring dashboard at /api/v1/monitoring/health (returns system status)
